title: Refuse `git checkout -B <current branch>` in an agent worktree; it left a stale index twice
why: Coordinator 14:34 CST: `git checkout -B <current branch>` in an agent worktree left a stale index twice.
note: A guard change, so a build lane (test-author, builder, reviewer). Done check: a red test on `git checkout -B <current branch>` in an agent worktree. Nov 7 22:47 CST: lane roadmap-push-refusal-says-fetch (#1777) hit it twice more: an agent's `git checkout -B` left old files in the worktree and index. Possible false alarm in the same incident: the shared-trees guard refused restoring stale staged files that match origin's blobs in an agent worktree; unchecked.
